_comment: Prompts used for flozic.ai entry-point connect creation tests. Each entry has a URL slug, a prompt, and an expected trigger. Entries with kind='agent' use the /agents/conversational/{slug} URL pattern; all others default to /integrate/apps/{slug}/integrations.

google-sheets.prompt: When a new row is added to my Google Sheet, create a HubSpot contact with the mapped fields and post a summary to my Slack sales channel.

gohighlevel.prompt: When a new opportunity is created in GoHighLevel V2, create a sale in Mindbody with the contact details.

cliniko.prompt: When a new patient is added in Cliniko, send a welcome email via Gmail and add the contact to HubSpot.

chatgpt.prompt: When a new Gmail email arrives, summarize it with ChatGPT and post the summary to a Slack channel.

housecall-pro.prompt: When a new job is scheduled in Housecall Pro, add it to Google Calendar and notify the team in Slack.

microsoft-excel.prompt: When a new row is added in Microsoft Excel, create a Trello card and email the assignee via Gmail.

telegram.prompt: When a new message is received in Telegram, summarize it with ChatGPT and save the result to Google Sheets.

mindbody.prompt: When a new client is added in Mindbody, create a contact in HubSpot and send a welcome email via Gmail.

gmail.prompt: When a new starred email arrives in Gmail, create a task in Trello and notify the team in Slack.

paypal.prompt: When a new PayPal payment is received, log it in Google Sheets and post a notification to Slack.

net-suite.prompt: When a new sales order is created in NetSuite, post a notification to Slack and email the team via Gmail.

acculynx.prompt: When a new lead is added in AccuLynx, send a welcome email via Gmail and create a task in Trello.

lightspeedxseries.prompt: When a new sale is recorded in Lightspeed X-Series, log it in Google Sheets and notify the team in Slack.

shopify.prompt: When a new order is created in Shopify, add the customer to HubSpot and send a confirmation email via Gmail.

flow-by-automate.prompt: When a new automation runs in Flow by Automate, log the result in Google Sheets and notify the team in Slack.

whatsappbusiness.prompt: When a new WhatsApp Business message arrives, log it in Google Sheets and notify the team in Slack.

discord-bot-maker-free.prompt: Build a Discord bot that greets new members in #welcome and answers FAQ questions about our product.

whatsapp-bot.prompt: Build a WhatsApp bot that captures customer name, email, and inquiry, then forwards the request to our sales team.

telegram-bot.prompt: Build a Telegram bot that sends daily reminders to subscribers and tracks their responses.

twitter-bot.prompt: Build a Twitter bot that auto-replies to brand mentions with a thank-you message and logs the user.

facebook-messenger-bot.prompt: Build a Facebook Messenger bot that answers product FAQs and books appointments for our team.
